name: Rohit Sharma Intercepting Virat Kohli Catch
visual_description: Rohit Sharma diving across the slip cordon to grab a catch right in front of a waiting Virat Kohli.
usage_context: Used to show someone swooping in to snatch credit, a task, or an opportunity right before someone else gets it.

example.top_text: Manager stepping in to send the final update email on a project I completed
